sim.capture-note.title: Capture note
sim.capture-note.where: Captured screen library, under a control
sim.capture-note.what: Opens what was written down about this one control when the real MSU page was read: what it appeared to do, and anything the person capturing it could not confirm.
sim.capture-note.when: Before you tell a professor how a control behaves. The note says whether the behaviour was seen or only assumed.
howTo: Click Capture note under any control.
Read the note, then check the Not observed list at the bottom of the screen for what is still unknown.
sim.capture-note.verify: If the note does not answer your question, the answer was never captured. Confirm it in a real course instead of guessing.
gotchas: A note describes one observation on one date. It is not documentation, and D2L changes between releases.

sim.library.screen-library.title: Screen library selector
sim.library.screen-library.what: Switches between the two sets of captured screens: the Brightspace pages read from the MSU sandbox, and the Gradescope pages reconstructed from vendor documentation.
sim.library.screen-library.when: Moving between a Brightspace question and a Gradescope one. The two have very different evidence behind them.
howTo: Choose a library from the list.
Read the banner that appears: the Gradescope set is documentation-based and was never observed live.
sim.library.screen-library.verify: The heading names the library you are in, and the Gradescope set always carries a Not observed warning.
gotchas: Anything in the Gradescope library is reconstructed from guides, so its layout and wording may not match what an instructor actually sees.

sim.library.find.title: Find a screen or setting
sim.library.find.what: Searches every captured screen by title, route and control label, so you can find the page a setting lives on without knowing D2L's menu structure.
sim.library.find.when: A professor names a setting and you do not yet know where it lives. This is usually the fastest way in.
howTo: Type part of the setting name, such as Special Access or Calculation.
sim.library.find.verify: The match count beside Captured screen tells you how many screens matched.
gotchas: It searches recorded labels only. A control that was never captured cannot be found here.

sim.library.search.title: Search screens
sim.library.search.what: Runs the search you typed and jumps to the first screen that matches.
sim.library.search.when: After typing in the find box.
howTo: Type a term in Find a screen or setting.
sim.library.search.verify: The screen picker beside it narrows to the matches and its count updates.

sim.library.screen-picker.title: Captured screen picker
sim.library.screen-picker.what: Lists every captured screen in the current library, narrowed by whatever you searched for. Choosing one opens it.
sim.library.screen-picker.when: Browsing what was captured, or moving between screens while working a ticket.
howTo: Open the list and choose a screen.
The page below redraws with that screen's controls, notes and gaps.
sim.library.screen-picker.verify: The blue callout under the picker names the screen and the route it sits on in real D2L.
gotchas: The list only holds screens that were actually captured. A missing page means nobody opened it, not that D2L lacks it.

sim.library.highlight.title: Highlight a captured control
sim.library.highlight.what: Outlines one control in red and scrolls to it, which is how you point someone at an exact setting on a busy page.
sim.library.highlight.when: Walking a colleague through where something is, or finding a control on a screen with dozens of them.
howTo: Choose a control from the list.
The page scrolls to it and draws a red outline around it.
sim.library.highlight.verify: The red outline appears on exactly one control.
gotchas: Controls with the same label are listed separately with their group, so pick the one in the right section.

sim.library.replay.title: Replay recorded tour
sim.library.replay.what: Opens the step-by-step replay of a recorded walkthrough, where each step outlines the control that was clicked and explains why.
sim.library.replay.when: Learning a whole task end to end rather than one setting.
howTo: Choose a tour, then step through with Next or press Play.
sim.library.replay.verify: Each step names its evidence level, so you can tell an observed step from a documented one.
gotchas: A tour is a recording, not a live course. Nothing you do in it changes the practice gradebook.

sim.library.page-text.title: Recorded page text
sim.library.page-text.where: Captured screen library, below the controls
sim.library.page-text.what: The raw text read off the real page, before it was broken into the control list above.
sim.library.page-text.when: Checking exact wording, or looking for something the control list may have dropped.
howTo: Expand Recorded page text and read it as the page appeared.
sim.library.page-text.verify: If wording here disagrees with a control label above, trust this: it is closer to the source.

sim.library.notes.title: Notes and transitions without a captured destination
sim.library.notes.where: Captured screen library, below the controls
sim.library.notes.what: Lists controls that were seen but never followed, with whatever was noted about where they would have led.
sim.library.notes.when: Working out whether a dead end in this simulator reflects D2L or just the limits of the capture.
howTo: Expand the section and look for the control you were trying to follow.
sim.library.notes.verify: If the control is listed here, its destination was never captured, so this app cannot show it.
gotchas: Some of these were deliberately not followed because clicking them in the real sandbox would have changed something.
